issues.description: The problem statement and UML use the abstract method name messageOnFeed(), but several places in the textual tasks refer to the same concept as getFeedingSound(). The reference implementation and UML use messageOnFeed(), whereas task descriptions and the feedAllAnimals explanation mention getFeedingSound(), which may lead students to implement the wrong method name or be confused about which method to call.
issues.suggestedFix: Standardize the method name across the problem statement, UML, template, and tests. Prefer using messageOnFeed() (as in the UML and solution) or change the UML/solution to getFeedingSound(). Update all textual references (e.g., the task descriptions and feedAllAnimals explanation) to the chosen identifier so students have a single, unambiguous method name to implement and call.
